[SWS_FrArTp_00064] ⌈A Flow Control frame is used in segmented 1:1 connections.
Thus, it cannot appear in a 1:n connection. It allows the receiver to send information
to the sender. It is sent after reception of an FF-x and after the last CF of a block if no
error occurred.⌋
